entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-08-20
entry.content:
Issues

  • [Blazor Hybrid] WebViewRenderer applies no backpressure — unacknowledged render batches accumulate without bound #68675

  • Perf regression: fortunes_ef, mvc, tls-renegotiation-kestrel #68661
